objective: Bind exact content selection to command identity and persist/recover the complete immutable resource closure with Linux generations.
decisions: Add command 0.3 with required package/preset pins; retain command 0.2 and resource-free generation 0.1 unchanged.
Construct immutable ResourceSet snapshots through the existing catalog; share selection/parent validation with previews and preserve exact original bytes.
Use the existing coordinator and asynchronous worker. Verify resource selection/theme/capabilities and recheck current policy before the commit permit.
Reject 0.2 edits of resource-bearing generations and new 0.3 work without a provider. Replay/reconciliation of stored requests needs no import path.
Advertise configuration.content only with a resource provider and require the negotiated document/feature/transaction dependencies and frame floor.
Generation manifest 0.2 binds resources.json and per-generation hash-named original manifests/assets. Flush resource files and directory before generation selection.
Reopen and validate the complete staged generation before publication; verify exact stored files, closure, selected theme and request identity at recovery.
Keep corrupt current generations intact and use only complete previous fallback under the existing read-only recovery rule.
Preserve the initial C++ helper indentation build failure, schema identity registration failure and missing-import tooling failure. Fix their causes without weakening expected results.
Keep all five release tracks open. Native supervised/installed content composition, decoding, editing and visible activation remain next boundaries.
